_help: Casting sheet for audio/gen_voices.py. Paste an ElevenLabs library voice ID (or its voice-library link) into voice_id. Voice IDs are not secrets; the API key goes in .env. Library voices only, no clones of real people. stability for the v3 model: 0.0 creative, 0.5 natural, 1.0 robust.

clown.name: Clown
clown.brief: Clown, the Court Jester. Narrates every scene and reads the question cards (about half of all lines). Playful and a little pompous, like a costume drama narrated by someone who's had one glass of wine. Never mean to the players.

hamlet.name: Hamlet
hamlet.brief: Prince Hamlet. Earnest young royal, flustered but game, with a dry joke under pressure ('An extremely purple one').

miranda.name: Miranda
miranda.brief: Princess Miranda. Warm but firm; she speaks for herself and gets the last word in both endings.

prospero.name: Prospero
prospero.brief: Duke Prospero, Miranda's father. Older, stern, proud and quick to judge; softens in the reconciliation ending.

tinman.name: Lord Tinman
tinman.brief: Lord Tinman, the heartless rival. Impeccably polite, composed, faintly smug.

cheapdate.name: Sir Cheapdate
cheapdate.brief: Sir Cheapdate, the tipsy rival. Jolly and sloppy, cheerfully aware of his own 'extensive, regrettable research'.

rutabaga.name: Count Rutabaga
rutabaga.brief: Count Rutabaga, the forgetful rival. Nervous, scattered and friendly; loses his train of thought mid-sentence.
